pitch_angle: Apply to the Replo Experts directory
what_they_sell: Page builder with an experts and agencies directory
audience: Shopify brands looking to hire a Replo builder
signal: replo.app/experts lists certified freelancers and says to email experts@replo.app for the Experts program

emails.subject: Replo Experts application: Ridwan Adekunle
emails.body:
Hi Replo Experts team,

I build Shopify landing pages and stores in Replo for DTC brands, and I publish my prices up front (page builds $600 to $900, conversion audits $150 to $250). I also write Replo comparisons for buyers, including Replo vs PageFly, Replo vs Shogun and Instant vs Replo.

I saw replo.app/experts and would like to apply. Could you tell me what the application needs? I can send my portfolio and client work.

Thanks
Hi, following up on my note about joining the Replo Experts directory. Happy to send my portfolio whenever it is useful.
